integrity: General results proved by operator-norm identity; exact finite computations are supplementary. Novelty comparisons remain subject to alternate formulations and unavailable full texts.
scientific_limitations: Finite linear deterministic habitat network; positive diagonal seasonal growth; a common unconditional dispersal rate; column-substochastic, diagonally symmetrizable movement. The three-season example proves existence, not universal three-season structure.
title: Two-season endpoint optimality and the first interior dispersal optimum
